laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Tongariro Northern Circuit: international adult NZD 66 a hut night in summer (about A$52.88, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); Whanganui Journey NZD 35.

layers.process: Tongariro Alpine Crossing: DOC recommends a track booking (free) for anyone using any part of the track, and a booking is needed to use a shuttle or guided walk service. Parking at the road ends is limited to 4 hours, and in summer there is no visitor parking at Mangatepopo car park, so DOC suggests a shuttle from a local town. Dogs are not allowed. A 10-year rāhui (a customary restriction) by Ngāti Hikairo ki Tongariro covers the area burnt in the 2025 fires: stay on the tracks and keep out of the burnt areas.
